I also come from a long line of Jews. I’m not particularly religious myself but my morals were shaped in part by the teachings of Judaism, of which “eradicate the Palestinians” was not one of them

Helping others, feeding people, and understanding strength in community—that’s what I learned.

Wild that anyone talks as if Zionism is a reasonable and acceptable political stance. It never was, and especially now it’s just staggering to see people proudly adhere to the label

a bit odd to proudly assert you want to establish an ethnostate on the other side of the world in ANY context
Aliens land on Earth but can only speak with dogs. What do they learn about our planet?

Hundreds inside an ICE concentration camp are on a work and hunger strike at Delaney Hall in New Jersey and other hunger strikes have been announced in New Mexico and Southern California. In Tacoma, WA, over 100 detainees announced the formation of the 'Union of People Kidnapped by ICE.'

Gonna come up with an international automobile standards agreement 

The Honda Accords

Gotta do market research before serving justice to this administration

Welcome to HISTORY with Endeavorance: "It's Very Accurate™"

Just posted the next episode of my Satisfactory let's play!

FINALLY building out the Coalral Palace, only to quickly realize we're gonna need more power than that...

Watch here: youtu.be/V4Fze_m6T3U
This machine costs like $3,000 market price. Listing files in a folder view should not be visually laggy.

I'm also noticing that most of the native mac apps (Mail, Finder, etc) seem to have a very noticeable lag between clicking on a folder and updating the contents of the folder view.

I'm suddenly finding myself doing double-checks because I can't tell if I've correctly clicked a folder or not
Also, those screenshots are *after* I dug in to the display settings to apply tweaks to reduce the visual flair

Anyway before anyone says something about Operating System XYZ being superior and that switching this computer's operating system is the solution:

1. shut
2. I use several different systems with different OSes daily and my personal machine runs linux
3. up

It gets much, much worse when a Finder window is unfocused. It gets a brighter, larger color differential between elements instead of *quieting* itself visually

(bonus tiny sliver of a video im editing in the background)

I did not expect to be thrown by the macOS Tahoe visual redesign since I’m used to it on iOS now but holy damn, apple has gone off the fucking deep end if they think this is a welcome change to improve clarity and focus while computing

Albert, no!

Every time I look at the calendar, they keep adding more days

I keep thinking I'm getting towards the end of it but nope; yet again, there's a month

Idk what I'm missing
I guess the people shooting at Trump are just carrying out self defense assassination attempts
